text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Work at Har Homa in East Jerusalem begins this morning.
- AT&T examining participation in tender for third Israeli cellular network.
- Strauss establishes team to examine buying Federman stake in Elite.
- Several Africa-Israel directors will submit resignations over sabbath closure policy.
- Insurance Authority to allow more foreign insurance companies to operate in Israel to boost competition.
- Palestinian President Arafat rejects Israeli package of gestures.
- Surveyors to work at Har Homa today.
- Finance Minister Meridor says Treasury not against more budget cuts.
- Israeli government, Cable and Wireless deny reported breakthrough on Bezeq.
- International Paper seeks sale of Scitex share.
- Arafat rejects package of Israeli gestures.
- High alert on Har Homa, work starts today.
